MID_TO_MID_RETURN.requires: two hash-verified actual quote receipts at declared times

ASK_TO_FUTURE_BID_NET_PROXY.requires: actual quotes, verified fee; never fills

POSITIVE_AFTER_COST_OPPORTUNITY.requires: same real quote and verified cost evidence

QUANTILE_RETURN_FORECAST.formula: conditional quantiles .1/.5/.9 of declared log-return label

receipt_policy: unknown legacy timestamps remain null; historical availability NOT asserted
feature_available_at: conservative latest recorded source receipt if entire symbol has receipts; otherwise null
target_observed_at: same conservative receipt bound, never target candle close relabelled as receipt
purge: target_end < next boundary - one bar; global across symbols
gaps: split contiguous verified segments; no interpolation
manifest: SHA256 verified bytes before loading; exact filenames and hashes frozen
research_45m: one fixed retrospective holdout, not repeated walk-forward
multiple_testing: every arm/seed recorded; correlated time and asset samples not independent; no significance claim
universe_selection_warning: Top-8 ranked by current observed catalog turnover, not a PIT historical universe; selection/survivorship bias possible
code_evolution: Initial source hashes retained separately; resume acceptance added after the primary run; all model input matrices are independently hashed

input_transform_audit.core_prices: log relative to last observed close inside each input window
input_transform_audit.normalization: mean/std of input window only; scale floor 1e-6; final clip [-20,20]
input_transform_audit.label: natural log return, not arithmetic executable return
